prompt:
Professional fashion photograph, full body shot. ONE woman.

a warm caramel complexion, early 20s goddess, apex siren physique THE MOST EXTREME PHYSICALLY POSSIBLE beyond all anatomy limits — an extraordinarily tall and curvaceous woman, far beyond any real person; everything about her is at its extreme at once: a towering frame with endless legs, a colossal heavy bust wider than her shoulders, a waist cinched to an impossible minimum, enormous round hips and a high rounded rear, gigantic thick thighs pressed together, smooth glowing skin over soft full curves; her silhouette is an exaggerated hourglass that dominates the whole frame from head to toe; her head looks small above her body; her arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other, blunt bob dark brown hair — wearing nothing but a neon pink glossy high-cut bodysuit with a deep front zip pulled open down to the navel and high-cut leg openings rising to the hip bones, every other part of her body, her shoulders, arms, stomach, thighs, legs, face and hands, plain bare real skin. Real photographic skin across her whole body, with visible pores and fine grain, fine peach-fuzz hairs and a faint natural flush on her cheeks and chest, a light scatter of faint freckles across her shoulders and upper arms and fine blue-green veins on the backs of her hands. The outfit sits on her skin with soft highlights, her skin tone running naturally everywhere else. Footwear: heels of the most absurdly extreme height imaginable, pointed platform stiletto pumps made of glossy scarlet red leather, each with a razor-thin tapered heel a full forty inches tall and a twelve-inch hidden front platform, her feet arched fully vertical on the very tips of her toes like a dancer on pointe, her legs stretched impossibly long and her whole body lifted far above the ground on them as if standing on stilts.
Nails: the longest nails physically imaginable, stiletto nails each as long as her forearm is wide, in scarlet red lacquer with a high polish.
Jewelry: a pair of large chandelier earrings of tin and blackened iron as her only jewelry, her neck, collarbones, chest, arms, wrists and fingers plain bare skin.
Face: her face is bare of any garment — real living flesh with real pores, a soft sheen of natural oils and bright real catchlights, the face of a real Latina woman with high cheekbones, large dark eyes and full lips, an unmistakably feminine face with a calm, composed expression, makeup: wet-look glass skin glowing as if coated in clear gel, strong liquid highlighter on the cheekbones, nose bridge and the center of the forehead, a flushed rosy blush, high-shine glossy lips.
Skin: the skin of a real living woman photographed with a macro lens at close range, every area of her body showing real pores, fine vellus hairs catching the light, a natural soft sheen of skin oils, subtle natural freckles and small beauty marks scattered across her shoulders, arms, stomach and thighs, a gentle uneven skin tone with a faint blush at the knees and elbows, and a soft warm translucency where the light passes through her skin, sharp enough to read every skin texture detail. Her skin shows satin skin finish, smooth silky sheen.

Background: a marble counter in a macro world where everyday objects are enormous: a gigantic open box of chocolates with glossy dark truffles each as big as a boulder, giant gold foil wrappers crinkled like sculptures, a giant raspberry and a giant red ribbon, a softly blurred cozy kitchen far behind; she is a tiny woman only six inches tall sitting on a giant glossy truffle with the giant objects rising far above her head, the whole scene clearly visible and in focus, lit by warm soft light with gentle shadows. ONE woman only. Full-length wide shot from a close distance with the camera at her eye level, the whole figure from the soles of her shoes to the top of her head completely visible, with the enormous chocolate truffles, foil wrappers and raspberry around her at their true giant scale so her tiny size and the extreme heel height read at a glance, the towering heels clearly separating the shoes from the floor. This is one single photograph taken with one camera at one moment, shot on a medium format camera with an 85mm lens at f/5.6, realistic photographic grain, a real photograph.
